FAQ.LABEL: FAQ
FAQ.TITLE: Frequently Asked Questions
FAQ.SUBTITLE: Everything you need to know about buying, selling, and managing property with Estatein.
FAQ.Q1: How do I start searching for a property?
FAQ.A1: Begin by using our search bar to filter by location, property type, or price range. You can also browse featured listings or reach out to one of our expert brokers for personalized guidance.
FAQ.Q2: What is the process for buying a property through Estatein?
FAQ.A2: Our process is simple: search and shortlist properties, schedule a viewing, submit an offer, and our team will guide you through due diligence, financing, and closing — every step of the way.
FAQ.Q3: Are there financing or mortgage options available?
FAQ.A3: Yes. We partner with leading financial institutions to offer competitive mortgage rates. Our advisors can help you explore financing options tailored to your budget and credit profile at no extra cost.
FAQ.A4: Our certified appraisers conduct a thorough market analysis comparing recent sales, property condition, location desirability, and amenities. You receive a detailed report within 48 hours.
FAQ.Q5: Can I list my property for sale or rent on Estatein?
FAQ.A5: Absolutely. Register as a property owner or broker, create your listing with photos and details, and our team will review and publish it within 24 hours. Premium featured placement is also available.
FAQ.Q6: What fees does Estatein charge buyers and sellers?
FAQ.A6: Browsing and searching is always free. For sellers and landlords, we charge a competitive commission only upon a successful transaction. Contact us for a full fee schedule breakdown.
